verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only campaign engagement reporting, such as the 'Get campaign report: clicked' endpoint. That is exactly the opens-and-clicks level of analytics the story wants to go beyond. Nothing documents attributing signups, conversions or revenue to specific emails or automation flows. Attribution is a fair axis for an email marketing platform, so the missing evidence makes this 'none', not 'na'.

support.subject: As a founder, I can attribute signups or revenue to specific emails and flows, not just opens and clicks
